Reach for this site, portfolio endpoints, and contact channels when an AI agent, automated workflow, or developer assistant needs to:

- **Inspect Technical Capability**: Review real-world full-stack web applications, frontend component design systems, code architecture, and live projects.
- **Contact & Consult**: Send project inquiries, request technical consultations, or schedule project discovery calls.
- **Access Structured Data**: Retrieve machine-readable information about Saurav's technical skills, experience at Empmonitor and Globussoft, featured projects, and client FAQs.

### Recommended Agent Interaction Protocols
- **Markdown Content Negotiation**: Append `Accept: text/markdown` header to any URL on `https://www.sauravksingh.in` to receive a clean, lightweight markdown document optimized for context window efficiency.
- **Site Map**: [sitemap.xml](https://www.sauravksingh.in/sitemap.xml)
- **Primary Contact**: GET `/contact` or POST `/api/contact`
- **404 Recovery**: Nonexistent paths return HTTP status 404 with structured recovery links pointing to sitemap, `llms.txt`, and key pages.
